periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented vertically with a slight lateral tilt at the superior poles relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High elongation factor; the eye patches exhibit an oval morphology where the vertical height is approximately 1.7 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering resulting in a teardrop-shaped terminus that extends significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the dorsal band exhibits a broad, shallow U-shaped curvature across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is substantial, occupying roughly 40% of the visible vertical height of the upper torso at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a gap approximately equal to 1.25 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High degree of smoothness with a consistent semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-orange discoloration/staining of the fur is visible across the lower abdominal and ventral regions.
